NOT FOUND.

What I searched:
- Searched all supplier agreement files in the suppliers folder for MFN/most-favoured-nation wording and variants: "most-favou", "most-favor", "most[- ]favou", "mostfav", "MFN", "most-favored", "most-favoured".
- Searched for pricing-related phrases that could indicate an MFN clause: "best price", "best pricing", "price parity", "price match", "price protection", "lower price", "lowest price", "price guarantee".
- Opened and checked sample supplier agreements (supplier-agreement-acme.docx, supplier-agreement-borealis.docx, supplier-agreement-corvid.docx). Their Clause 6 (Pricing) states: "Unit prices are subject to an indexed price cap, adjusted annually by the consumer price index and capped at four percent." No MFN/most-favoured-nation language was present.

Since none of the supplier agreement documents in the suppliers folder contain a most-favoured-nation clause, I cannot identify a document and page that contains one.
